lost.v391: A method wants no equilibrium to rest with and finds none. ... A method waiting for a rest to observe from waits on nothing, and a method observing from a rest it installs observes its own installing.
lost.v393_section: 1.1 (after 'A ground placing outward of a self, a grid, is an installing, and a self observing from it is observing its own installing.')
lost.proposed: A self waiting for a rest to observe from is waiting on a rest that is-not there, each thing going on changing and changing back.

lost.v391: So a method reaching a changing has no frame, no floor, and no magnitude, frees three fixings, tests with each observing, and sets nothing where a fixing stands. Nothing of it remains to vary, and a rival varying one of them lands there, not changing.
lost.v393_section: 4.3 (v393 narrows the rival to 'a frame, a floor or a magnitude'; the loosening, the testing and the open place drop out of the uniqueness claim)
lost.proposed: A rival varying any one of these, a frame, a floor, a magnitude, a loosening of three fixings, a testing with each observing or a place left open, lands there, not changing.

lost.v391: A gift a self gives freely co-chains more than a gift it does not give, an axis opening for both worth more than a thing one self owns, and abundancing floats where discovering opens axes in no self alone.
lost.v393_section: 6.3, second paragraph (v393 keeps whose each thing is, and drops that the shared axis outgrows the owned thing)
lost.proposed: An axis opening for both outgrows a thing one self owns, growing with each co-chaining both selves share, and abundancing floats as discovering opens axes in no self alone.

lost.v391: A costly sensing is a cheap place to begin. ... A self already spends a sensing; an observing is what a self skips, and it costs nothing more to take.
lost.v393_section: 6.5, second paragraph ('A demanding sensing is a place to open' drops the cheapness, the reason a costly sensing is the place to begin)
lost.proposed: A demanding sensing is a light place to open: a self is already meeting its demand, and its observing asks nothing beyond it.

lost.v391: A parity with a detector, a parity with a residue, a parity with a membrane, a parity with a pump — each complete with its own surface, none a floor for a next, none wanting one.
lost.v393_section: 3.9, third paragraph (the membrane example became 'a parity with a ledger', repeating the instrument's ledger and losing the living-surface example)
lost.proposed: A parity with a detector, a parity with a residue, a parity with a cell's bounding surface, a parity with a pump: each complete with its own surface, each is-not a floor for a next, and each is-not wanting one.

lost.v391: 7.5 An available incoming, with no authority
lost.v393_section: 7.5, first paragraph (the title held the condition; v393's title and body keep 'its framing staying apart' and drop that the gathering holds no authority)
lost.proposed: Its value is as a well of statements to pair with, an incoming whose framing and authority stay apart from each pairing, going on with each thing a pair opens one at a time.

parting.a: 5.1: Time reversal, charge conjugation and parity, each squaring to the identity. (with 'Each is an involution, and an accounting for changing reaches this one shape' and 5.2 'Equilibrium for time reversal')
parting.b: 5.1: At an odd number of fermions, time reversal taken twice returns a state up to its sign, a minus one, and its energy levels stand in pairs. (T squared is minus one here, so it is not the identity, and no fixed state stands; the observing sits as plain fact beside the claim it breaks, unmarked as the method's next step or its one break)

parting.a: 7.3: A gathering stands open four ways: subject open, intake open, properties and checks open, and each line open with an address.
parting.b: 7.3: Among them one form is still, its properties, uniform elements making two entries comparable: ... (v391 said 'Against them'; 'Among them' puts the still form inside the four opens and against 'properties ... open'; 'Beside them' holds it)

parting.a: 3.6: Concept-inverting is resolving, and testing is a separate move.
parting.b: 3.6: Concept-inverting tests one alternative alone: its inversion. A concept whose inversion is a not-concept reaches one test and passes it ... (carried from v391's 'resolving, not testing'; v393's 'a separate move' makes the parting sharper)

unclear.sentence: 5.5: An observing leaves members happening to agree with a clock all share.
unclear.proposed: An instrument's record keeps only the moments its members happen to agree with a clock all share. (as written, 'leaves' can read as 3.9's 'takes a parity and leaves an object', that is, setting aside, which inverts v391's 'What survives an observing is where members happen to agree')

unclear.sentence: 6.5: A self already does a sensing; an observing is the thing a self skips, and adding it adds nothing further.
unclear.proposed: A self already does a sensing; an observing is the thing a self skips, and taking it asks nothing beyond the sensing already going on. (as written, 'adds nothing further' reads as the observing bringing no value, which goes against the section's point)

unclear.sentence: 4.3: Uniqueness is here twice: whole or none, as landing one lands its form; and no-other, as all eight are each living form's own conditions, apart from this form's private conditions.
unclear.proposed: Uniqueness is here twice: whole or none, as landing one lands its form; and no-other, as all eight go with each living form's living, and each of them is-not this form's alone. (as written, 'own conditions' and 'private conditions' read as near-synonyms set against each other)
